summary: Indian markets exhibit mixed trends as global headwinds from rising US Treasury yields and Fed rate hike fears dampen sentiment. While the IT sector and Tata group stocks face selling pressure, the smartphone manufacturing sector sees a boost from record exports to the US. Investors remain cautious with sentiment at a 16-month low ahead of a busy IPO week.
